description: Update an app's configuration. Pass only the fields you want to change. Use addDomain/removeDomain to mutate the allowed-origins list atomically without overwriting other entries. `sandbox: true` lets the app load on localhost / non-https origins for development. `ai` is the AI proxy config for the SDK's neblla.ai() — set { model, maxOutputTokens, userTokenMode, presets, limitsEnabled, tokensPerDay } or null to disable. userTokenMode is one of: 'off' (server uses dev key only), 'browser' (user key, browser-direct), 'server' (user key, server-side with private preset prefixes). presets is a {name: prefix} map of named prompt prefixes invoked via neblla.ai({preset:'name'}). limitsEnabled + tokensPerDay cap how many Claude tokens each end-user can spend per day; only applied when userTokenMode = off. `inbox: true` enables the in-app communications inbox feature for end users. `community` configures user-published entries (neblla.community, see the comunidad guide section): { mode: "open"|"review"|"closed", whoPublishes: "users"|"moderators", maxPayloadBytes, categories[], contentTypes[], maxEntriesPerUser, rules }. The community feature itself is enabled with `features: { community: true }` (it needs login).

addDomain.description: Append a domain entry (URL or origin) to the allowed list

ai.description: AI proxy config: { model, maxOutputTokens, userTokenMode, presets, limitsEnabled, tokensPerDay } — pass null to disable

community.description: Community config (user-published entries): { mode, whoPublishes, maxPayloadBytes, categories, contentTypes, maxEntriesPerUser, rules }. Merged over the stored config.

features.description: Feature switches to merge into the app: { multiplayer, communications, purchases, ai, friends, login, anticheat, community } as booleans. Only the keys you pass change.

inbox.description: Enable/disable in-app communications inbox for end users

matchmaking.description: No-code matchmaking config: { mode: "nocode"|"custom", rule: "count"|"timer"|"count_then_timer"|"button", minPlayers, maxPlayers (0=unlimited), waitSeconds, allowPresenterStart }. In "nocode" mode this regenerates server/gathering.js from the rules; in "custom" mode you own that file.

removeDomain.description: Remove a domain entry exactly matching this string

sandbox.description: Allow non-https / localhost loads for development

name: neblla_update_app
